name: drupal-migrate
description: Agnostic Drupal content-migration toolkit for migrations from WordPress or Drupal 7/8+ sources (another CMS is identified and reported, not audited): atomic source-database analysis skills, a documentation-organization skill, a post-migration content-verification skill, and an orchestrating migration-analyst agent. All skills read project-specific values from .agents/references/migrate/project-config.md, so the plugin stays project-agnostic.
